configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Raspberry Pi Pico / RP2040 module. Requires the ARM Cortex-M0+ toolchain (install via the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code extension), exported as PICO_TOOLCHAIN_PATH.

configurePresets.name: product
configurePresets.description: RP2354B (48 GPIOs, 2 MB stacked flash), RISC-V toolchain. Uses the pico2 board header as a stand-in until a dedicated RP2354B header exists.
